title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
text: Retrieval-augmented generation combines parametric and non-parametric memory for language generation. The original RAG paper evaluates retrieval-augmented models on knowledge-intensive tasks.

title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
text: Language model performance can vary with the position of relevant information in the input context. Lost in the Middle studies this effect using multi-document question answering and key-value retrieval.

title: BEIR: A Heterogeneous Benchmark for Zero-shot Evaluation of Information Retrieval Models
text: BEIR provides a heterogeneous benchmark for evaluating information retrieval models. The benchmark includes diverse retrieval tasks and domains.

title: The Probabilistic Relevance Framework: BM25 and Beyond
text: BM25 is a ranking function within the probabilistic relevance framework. It incorporates term frequency saturation and document length normalization.
